description: This file defines the Monographs class for managing publication, unpublication, and analytics of monographs within the Notesnook project. It includes methods for publishing notes as monographs, unpublishing, retrieving monograph data, and handling encryption/decryption of passwords.

classes.name: Monographs
classes.description: Class for managing monograph publication, unpublication, and analytics within the Notesnook app.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the list of published monographs and the collection.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the list of monograph IDs from the database.

methods.name: isPublished
methods.description: Checks if a note is published as a monograph.

methods.name: monograph
methods.description: Retrieves the monograph ID for a given note.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes a note as a monograph, handling encryption and API communication.

methods.name: unpublish
methods.description: Unpublishes a monograph, removing it from the collection and database.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns a filtered collection of all published notes that are not deleted.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific monograph by ID.

methods.name: analytics
methods.description: Fetches analytics data (total views) for a monograph.
